unvalued.description: Values without a USD value per bucket, as unvalued_count.
unvalued.title: unvalued

unvaluedCount.description:
Deposits, payouts and fees summed above without a USD value, and so
 left out of the USD totals: from the last few minutes, not valued by a
 current price in time, or from before USD values existed.
unvaluedCount.title: unvalued_count

vaultAccountId.description:
Public sub-account ID of a vault, for the VAULT breakdown: the
 QuickSwaps that credited it a broker or affiliate fee. Its fees are
 the fees credited to the vault.
vaultAccountId.title: vault_account_id

swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerStatsSeries.title: BrokerStatsSeries

swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerUsage.description:
BrokerUsage is the broker's current use of its limits, counted exactly as
 the limits are enforced: the next create is refused while a count is at or
 above its limit on Broker. A count can be above its limit after the limit
 is lowered. The counts are read when the request is served and can change
 right after with concurrent creates, deposits and expiring funding windows.

affiliateVaults.description:
Affiliate vaults created, active and disabled together, counted against
 Broker.max_affiliate_vaults.
affiliateVaults.title: affiliate_vaults

createsLastHour.description:
QuickSwaps created in the last hour, counted against
 Broker.max_creates_per_hour.
createsLastHour.title: creates_last_hour

unfundedAddresses.description:
Unfunded QuickSwaps held now, counted against
 Broker.max_unfunded_addresses.
unfundedAddresses.title: unfunded_addresses

swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerUsage.title: BrokerUsage

swap.quickswap.v1.ChargedFee.description:
ChargedFee is a fee charged on a QuickSwap in one asset, from settled
 fills and bridge payouts, summed per kind and credited account.

accountId.description:
Public sub-account ID of the credited vault: the default vault for
 BROKER, the affiliate vault for AFFILIATE; zero for SERVICE, credited
 to Polyester, and for REFERRAL.
accountId.title: account_id

amount.description: Amount charged, in base units of 18 decimals.
amount.title: amount

assetId.description:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
assetId.title: asset_id

valueUsd.description:
USD value of amount, each fee summed in it valued at its asset's USD
 price when it was charged, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down.
 Each fee is valued once, within minutes of being charged, and never
 repriced. Unset while any fee summed in amount has no USD value: one
 charged in the last few minutes, one no current price valued in time,
 or one charged before USD values existed; never zero for unknown.
valueUsd.title: value_usd

swap.quickswap.v1.ChargedFee.title: ChargedFee

swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeReque.description: CheckReferralCodeRequest asks whether the caller may take a code.

code.description: The code; letters are compared case-insensitively.
code.title: code

swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeReque.title: CheckReferralCodeRequest

swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeRespo.description:
CheckReferralCodeResponse answers for the code. The answer can change
 before SetReferralCode if another partner takes the code first.

availability.description: Whether the caller may take it.
availability.title: availability

code.description: The code in lower case; empty when it is CODE_INVALID.
code.title: code

swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeRespo.title: CheckReferralCodeResponse

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultRe.description:
CreateAffiliateVaultRequest creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with a
 label.

broker.description: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.
broker.title: broker

label.description:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace, unique
 per broker. The same label always returns the same vault.
label.title: label

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultRe.title: CreateAffiliateVaultRequest

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyRequest.description: CreateKeyRequest creates a broker API key.

broker.description: Broker name.
broker.title: broker

label.description:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace,
 Unicode spaces such as the no-break space included.
label.title: label

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyRequest.title: CreateKeyRequest

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyResponse.description:
CreateKeyResponse returns the key and its token. The token is shown only
 here and cannot be recovered.

token.description: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret>. Store it as a server secret.
token.title: token

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyResponse.title: CreateKeyResponse

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRequest.description:
CreateQuickSwapRequest creates, or returns, the QuickSwap for one
 idempotency key.
broker_bps and the affiliates' bps must total at most 300
referral_code cannot be combined with affiliates
refund_zipped_asset_id and refund_address must be set together, and refund_memo requires refund_address

affiliates.description:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.
each affiliate vault may be named once
affiliates.title: affiliates

brokerBps.description:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none,
 at most 300. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300.
brokerBps.title: broker_bps

destinationAddress.description:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.
destinationAddress.title: destination_address

destinationMemo.description:
Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the
 destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when
 unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
destinationMemo.title: destination_memo

idempotencyKey.description:
Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits,
 '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained
 permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap
 and deposit address; with a different request it fails with
 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and
 memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in
 another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is
 ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.
idempotencyKey.title: idempotency_key

referralCode.description:
Optional referral partner code from a referral link, case-insensitive,
 at most 64 bytes; empty for none. Only a broker with a referral program may send one
 (REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise), never with affiliates.
 It must be a valid code (REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID) that is a partner's
 code (REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN), and the partner must be active
 (REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE). A code the partner has since replaced with
 SetReferralCode keeps crediting that partner. The program's current rates
 for the route are applied (quote.referral) and fixed at creation. It is
 part of the request: the same idempotency_key with another code, or with
 and without one, is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
referralCode.title: referral_code

refundAddress.description:
Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network,
 in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
refundAddress.title: refund_address

refundMemo.description:
Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
refundMemo.title: refund_memo

refundZippedAssetId.description:
Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an
 AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id
 is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET
 /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required
 with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional
 and unused otherwise.
refundZippedAssetId.title: refund_zipped_asset_id

returnAddress.description:
Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not
 accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an
 observed sender.
returnAddress.title: return_address

returnMemo.description:
Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.
returnMemo.title: return_memo

sourceWallet.description:
Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that
 know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at
 most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap. It is risk screened
 before the deposit address is issued: a wallet that fails screening
 makes the QuickSwap REJECTED, bound to the key, without a deposit
 address, and the request and every repeat of it fail with
 SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED. Source wallets are screened in advance on
 Bitcoin, Solana and most EVM networks. Wallets on other networks,
 including the Bitcoin and Solana test networks, and wallets whose
 screening is unavailable at the time, get their address without it.
 Every deposit is still screened on arrival, so a deposit sent from
 another wallet is judged on its own sender.
sourceWallet.title: source_wallet

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRequest.title: CreateQuickSwapRequest

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRespons.description: CreateQuickSwapResponse returns the QuickSwap bound to the idempotency key.

quickSwap.description:
The QuickSwap, normally AWAITING_DEPOSIT with deposit_instructions. A
 retry returns its current state with the original quote and address.
quickSwap.title: quick_swap

swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRespons.title: CreateQuickSwapResponse

swap.quickswap.v1.Deposit.description: Deposit is one deposit detected on the QuickSwap's deposit address.

amount.description:
Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.
amount.title: amount

confirmations.description:
Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network
 reports any. Never decreases.
confirmations.title: confirmations

creditedAt.description:
When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not
 decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one
 then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is
 returned (RETURN_ONLY).
creditedAt.title: credited_at

detectedAt.description:
When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with
 funding_expires_at.
detectedAt.title: detected_at

directReturn.description:
Direct return to return_address of a deposit that was never credited: a
 RETURN_ONLY deposit that reached the address after its one eligible
 deposit, after its funding window or after the address retired. Unset
 until a direct return is recorded, and on every other deposit, which is
 returned through withdrawals.
directReturn.title: direct_return

flowId.description:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow
 amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.
flowId.title: flow_id

index.description:
Zero-based position in deposits, which lists deposits oldest first. Not
 stable: a deposit detected earlier can appear later, for example a
 dropped or replaced deposit that confirms after all, and then shifts the
 index of every deposit after it. Identify a deposit by tx_hash with
 tx_occurrence_index, not by index.
index.title: index

networkFee.description:
Deposit network fee that Zipper withheld from this deposit when it
 took the deposit in, in zipped_asset_id's token units; zero when it
 charged none. Unset until Zipper has taken the deposit in, and on a
 deposit it never takes in: a deposit returned or transferred out
 without being credited, whose deductions are not reported.
networkFee.title: network_fee

reason.description:
Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY or ON_HOLD; REASON_UNSPECIFIED
 otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific
 reason.
reason.title: reason

requiredConfirmations.description: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.
requiredConfirmations.title: required_confirmations

txHash.description: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.
txHash.title: tx_hash

txOccurrenceIndex.description: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.
txOccurrenceIndex.title: tx_occurrence_index

zippedAssetId.description:
Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until
 Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection,
 and when the asset is not a supported route.
zippedAssetId.title: zipped_asset_id

swap.quickswap.v1.Deposit.title: Deposit

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositAddressState.description: DepositAddressState is the lifecycle state of a QuickSwap deposit address.
swap.quickswap.v1.DepositAddressState.title: DepositAddressState

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositDisposition.description: DepositDisposition is what a detected deposit is allowed to do.
swap.quickswap.v1.DepositDisposition.title: DepositDisposition

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositInstructions.description: DepositInstructions tell the end user where and until when to deposit.

address.description: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.
address.title: address

addressRetiresAt.description:
After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to
 it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap
 is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is
 returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return
 reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester
 records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap
 reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker
 support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals
 funding_expires_at.
 After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until
 Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the
 QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all
 payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before
 funding_expires_at.
addressRetiresAt.title: address_retires_at

addressState.description: Current lifecycle state of the address.
addressState.title: address_state

fundingExpiresAt.description:
End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7
 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it
 before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and
 confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time
 never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after
 the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals
 this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send
 deposits well before this time. Never changes.
fundingExpiresAt.title: funding_expires_at

issuedAt.description:
When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts
 here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.
issuedAt.title: issued_at

memo.description:
Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source
 network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.
memo.title: memo

minNativeGasLimit.description:
Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM
 networks to succeed reliably: 250000. Polyester does not enforce it; the
 sender's wallet or exchange sets the gas limit. A gas estimate from the
 network of at least 50000 also works, but confirms more slowly. The gas
 a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and
 EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails
 on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero
 for token deposits and non-EVM networks.
minNativeGasLimit.title: min_native_gas_limit

zippedAssetId.description: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.
zippedAssetId.title: zipped_asset_id

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositInstructions.title: DepositInstructions

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturn.description:
DepositReturn is a deposit's direct return to return_address. It pays the
 return address only, never the deposit's sender, in the asset and on the
 network the deposit was received in.

state.description: Return progress. Accept state values added later.
state.title: state

txHash.description:
Return transaction on the deposit's network, in the network's native
 text form; set only once RETURN_COMPLETED, and then never changes.
txHash.title: tx_hash

updatedAt.description: When the return last changed state.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturn.title: DepositReturn

swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturnState.description: DepositReturnState is the progress of a deposit's direct return.
swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturnState.title: DepositReturnState

swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerR.description: EnrollReferralPartnerRequest applies to become a referral partner.

displayName.description:
Name shown for the partner, at most 64 characters. Leading and trailing
 spaces are removed; at least one other character must remain.
displayName.title: display_name

earningsSubaccountId.description:
Public sub-account ID of an active sub-account the caller owns, to be
 credited with the commissions. It cannot be changed later or be used by
 another partner.
earningsSubaccountId.title: earnings_subaccount_id

swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerR.title: EnrollReferralPartnerRequest

swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerR.description:
EnrollReferralPartnerResponse returns the new partner, pending review, with
 a random 8-character code.
swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerR.title: EnrollReferralPartnerResponse

swap.quickswap.v1.Execution.description: Execution selects how the credited deposit is traded.
swap.quickswap.v1.Execution.title: Execution

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress.description: ExecutionProgress is the trading progress of a QuickSwap.

completedSlices.description:
Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when
 execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is
 over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes.
 Zero for a bridge.
completedSlices.title: completed_slices

deadline.description:
Execution deadline frozen during planning: the planned start plus the TWAP
 duration or market execution window. A later first submission does not move
 this deadline. Funds not converted by then are refunded or returned.
 Independent of the quote validity and the funding window. Unset until
 the execution is planned, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.
deadline.title: deadline

executedInput.description:
Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route
 this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.
executedInput.title: executed_input

finishedAt.description: When execution finished; unset while executing.
finishedAt.title: finished_at

inputAmount.description: Credited amount committed to execution, in source token units.
inputAmount.title: input_amount

intermediateRemainder.description:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset acquired but not yet converted, in
 the refund route's token units; unset for a direct route and a bridge.
intermediateRemainder.title: intermediate_remainder

outputAmount.description:
Destination amount acquired so far after service, broker and affiliate
 fees and before withdrawal network fees, in destination token units. Zero for a
 bridge: its destination withdrawal pays the credit less its fees.
outputAmount.title: output_amount

slices.description:
Planned slices in increasing index order, at most 50. Includes future and
 active slices. Empty for a bridge, or when slices_unavailable_reason is set.
 When available and not truncated, input_traded and
 output_received sum to executed_input and output_amount respectively;
 completed entries count to completed_slices and the list has total_slices
 entries. Amounts are rounded cumulatively in index order.
slices.title: slices

slicesTruncated.description:
True when more than 50 slices exist; only the first 50 are listed.
 Totals and completed_slices still cover the entire execution.
slicesTruncated.title: slices_truncated

slicesUnavailableReason.description:
Why slice history is unavailable. When set, slices is empty and
 slices_truncated is false. Counts, execution status and withdrawals
 remain available, and so do the aggregate amounts, except that with
 PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE an amount in a token whose precision is
 unavailable is unset. Unspecified when history is available.
slicesUnavailableReason.title: slices_unavailable_reason

startedAt.description:
When the first slice was submitted for execution. Unset while all slices
 remain unsent, including an execution refused during planning. Planned
 slice times and the execution deadline do not imply a slice was sent.
startedAt.title: started_at

totalSlices.description:
Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP
 has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero
 until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.
totalSlices.title: total_slices

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress.title: ExecutionProgress

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress.Slic.description: SlicesUnavailableReason explains why slice details cannot be shown.
swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress.Slic.title: SlicesUnavailableReason

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.description:
ExecutionSlice is one planned execution slot, including a slot that trades
 nothing. Its index and planned_at never change.

averagePrice.description:
Net destination tokens per source token for this slot, rounded down to
 18 decimal places; empty when no source input traded. A two-leg slot's
 output can include conversion of funds carried from previous slots.
averagePrice.title: average_price

carryReason.description:
Why intermediate funds could not be converted in this slot; unspecified
 when no conversion was refused.
carryReason.title: carry_reason

completed.description:
Whether this slice contributes to completed_slices. A final market slice
 completes even if it traded nothing; a TWAP slice completes only if it
 traded source input and is over.
completed.title: completed

executedAt.description: When its first order was sent; unset for an unsent slice.
executedAt.title: executed_at

finishedAt.description: When its outcome became final; unset while planned or executing.
finishedAt.title: finished_at

index.description: Zero-based position in the execution's frozen schedule.
index.title: index

inputTraded.description: Source input traded, in source token units, counting only the first leg.
inputTraded.title: input_traded

intermediateCarried.description:
Intermediate balance after this slot's recorded fills, including earlier
 carried funds, in the refund route's token units; unset on a direct route.
 It passes to later slots while executing, or to refund when execution ends.
intermediateCarried.title: intermediate_carried

outputReceived.description:
Destination received after all trading fees, in destination token units.
 On a two-leg route this is the second leg's output in this slot, which
 can include conversion of intermediate funds from earlier slots.
outputReceived.title: output_received

plannedAt.description: Frozen scheduled start time of this slot.
plannedAt.title: planned_at

reason.description: Why a final slice did not trade in full; unspecified after full trading.
reason.title: reason

secondLeg.description: Second-leg conversion; unset on a direct route or a bridge.
secondLeg.title: second_leg

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.title: ExecutionSlice

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.Reason.description: Reason explains a slice outcome or why intermediate funds were carried.
swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.Reason.title: Reason

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.SecondL.description:
SecondLeg is the intermediate-to-destination conversion in this slot.
 It may spend intermediate funds carried from earlier slots as well.

averagePrice.description:
Net destination tokens per intermediate token, rounded down to 18
 decimal places; empty when no intermediate amount traded.
averagePrice.title: average_price

inputTraded.description: Intermediate amount traded, in the refund route's token units.
inputTraded.title: input_traded

outputReceived.description: Destination amount received after all trading fees, in destination units.
outputReceived.title: output_received

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.SecondL.title: SecondLeg

swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.State.description: State distinguishes pending work from a final slice outcome.
swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.State.title: State

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerDeposit.description:
ExplorerDeposit is one deposit a completed QuickSwap executed: the
 credited deposit that funded it. A deposit that was returned or held is
 never listed.

address.description:
QuickSwap deposit address the deposit was paid into, in the source
 network's canonical text form, without a destination tag or memo.
address.title: address

txHash.description:
Source-network transaction that sent the deposit, in the network's
 canonical text form, as GetQuickSwap reports it in Deposit.tx_hash.
txHash.title: tx_hash

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerDeposit.title: ExplorerDeposit

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerQuickSwap.description:
ExplorerQuickSwap is the public view of one completed QuickSwap. Besides
 its assets, amounts and markets, it carries the transactions and
 addresses of its deposit and destination payout. It never carries a
 destination tag or memo, a return or refund address or transaction, the
 broker, a fee, an idempotency key or the quote. Fields may be added;
 clients ignore the ones they do not know.

completedAt.description: When the QuickSwap completed: its destination payout was final.
completedAt.title: completed_at

deposits.description:
The credited deposits that funded the QuickSwap, oldest first: one in
 practice.
deposits.title: deposits

destinationAmount.description:
Amount delivered to the destination, in destination token units, after
 the withdrawal network fee.
destinationAmount.title: destination_amount

destinationValueUsd.description:
USD value of what the destination was paid, fixed when its payout was
 requested, as QuickSwap.delivered_value_usd. Like source_value_usd, it
 is unset when it has none, and can be set a few minutes after
 completed_at.
destinationValueUsd.title: destination_value_usd

destinationZippedAssetId.description:
Destination asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id
 from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
destinationZippedAssetId.title: destination_zipped_asset_id

legs.description:
Markets traded, in route order: one for a direct route, two for a route
 through an intermediate asset, none for a bridge, which moves one asset
 between networks without trading.
legs.title: legs

sourceAmount.description:
Amount deposited, in source token units, before the deposit network
 fee.
sourceAmount.title: source_amount

sourceValueUsd.description:
USD value of the deposit taken into execution, fixed when it was taken
 in, as QuickSwap.deposited_value_usd: in base units of 18 decimals,
 rounded down, never repriced. Unset when it has none: not valued by a
 current price in time, or from before USD values existed; never zero
 for unknown.
sourceValueUsd.title: source_value_usd

sourceZippedAssetId.description:
Source asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
sourceZippedAssetId.title: source_zipped_asset_id

withdrawals.description:
The finalized payouts to the destination, oldest first: one in
 practice. destination_amount is their total.
withdrawals.title: withdrawals

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerQuickSwap.title: ExplorerQuickSwap

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerRouteLeg.description:
ExplorerRouteLeg is one market a completed QuickSwap traded on, in route
 order.

symbolId.description:
Numeric spot market identifier of the pair traded; resolve its symbol
 with GetSpotConfig.
symbolId.title: symbol_id

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerRouteLeg.title: ExplorerRouteLeg

swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerWithdrawal.description:
ExplorerWithdrawal is one finalized payout of a completed QuickSwap's
 output to its destination. A refund or return is never listed.

address.description:
Address the output was paid to, in the destination network's canonical
 text form (for example lowercase hex on EVM networks), without a
 destination tag or memo.
address.title: address

txHash.description:
Destination-network transaction that paid the output, in the network's

swap.quickswap.v1.ListCompletedQuickSwap.description:
ListCompletedQuickSwapsRequest lists completed QuickSwaps of every broker,
 optionally only those matching every filter given. A side's filters match
 a QuickSwap whose asset and network is any of its zipped_asset_ids, or on
 any network of any of its asset_ids. The source and destination
 filters together may select at most 400 routes (source and destination
 asset and network pairs), counting each asset_id as all its networks.
 QuickSwaps created before the Explorer launched never match an asset
 filter, and those without a source_value_usd never match a USD bound.

 A USD bound is 0 or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to
 $1,000,000,000: $1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, $100 and so on. With a USD
 bound, the list holds only QuickSwaps that completed at least 5 minutes
 before it is read, when their source_value_usd is final, so it lags
 completion by up to 5 minutes. The routes times the value steps the range
 covers may be at most 400, counted from the request alone: the steps run
 $0 to $1, $1 to $2, $2 to $5, $5 to $10 and so on up to $1,000,000,000 and
 above, the last one, so a range without a maximum covers the steps from
 its minimum to the last.

destinationAssetIds.description:
Only QuickSwaps to one of these assets, on any of their networks, as
 source_asset_ids; at most 20.
destinationAssetIds.title: destination_asset_ids

destinationZippedAssetIds.description:
Only QuickSwaps to one of these destination assets and networks, as
 source_zipped_asset_ids; at most 20.
destinationZippedAssetIds.title: destination_zipped_asset_ids

limit.description: Maximum number of QuickSwaps to return; 0 means 50, at most 100.
limit.title: limit

maxSourceValueUsd.description:
Only QuickSwaps whose source_value_usd is below this: a bound on the
 grid, in base units of 18 decimals, above min_source_value_usd when both
 are set, so never 0 alone. Unset (empty) for no upper bound.
max_source_value_usd must be 0 or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to $1,000,000,000 ($1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, ...): base units 0, or 1, 2 or 5 followed by 18 to 26 zeros, or 1 followed by 27 zeros
maxSourceValueUsd.title: max_source_value_usd

minSourceValueUsd.description:
Only QuickSwaps whose source_value_usd is at least this: a bound on the
 grid, in base units of 18 decimals as source_value_usd.base_units, for
 example 100000000000000000000 for $100. Unset (empty) for no lower
 bound.
min_source_value_usd must be 0 or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to $1,000,000,000 ($1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, ...): base units 0, or 1, 2 or 5 followed by 18 to 26 zeros, or 1 followed by 27 zeros
minSourceValueUsd.title: min_source_value_usd

swap.quickswap.v1.ListPayoutsResponse.description:
ListPayoutsResponse lists payouts newest first by scheduled slot. Runs of
 the same slot follow a stable server-defined order, the same on every
 page; it does not follow run_id. next_page_token marks a position in the
 run history, in that order. Without a status filter it is the last payout
 returned. On any page filtered by status, a full one included, the
 position can lie past the last payout returned: when the page uses up its
 scan before finding another match, it is the last run the page examined.
 A page may hold fewer than limit payouts, or none, while next_page_token
 is set and matching payouts remain; keep paging until next_page_token is
 empty. A complete traversal, followed until next_page_token is empty,
 lists every payout that matched throughout it exactly once, in order. A
 run started meanwhile past the position, for an older slot, is listed by
 a later page. A run started meanwhile at or before the position,
 including one between the last payout returned and the position, and a
 run there whose status changes meanwhile into the filter (in progress
 becoming paid, for example) appear only in a listing started again from
 the first page.

swap.quickswap.v1.ListReferralLedgerResp.description:
ListReferralLedgerResponse lists ledger entries newest first by
 occurred_at, as ListVaultLedger does: each referral commission credited to
 the earnings sub-account (FEE_CREDIT with fee_kind REFERRAL), and each
 auto-withdraw payout that left it (PAYOUT_DEBIT), with its refund
 (PAYOUT_REFUND). A credit's occurred_at is rounded down to the minute,
 and the credits of one minute follow a fixed order that does not follow
 when they were credited. At one time, payouts come before credits and a
 refund before its debit. It carries no running balance and lists no other
 movement of the sub-account, such as a withdrawal or transfer the partner
 makes itself: read the balance and every movement with
 LedgerReadService. Paging lists exactly once every entry that sorts after the previous
 page's last entry when the next page is read. A page may hold fewer than

swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStep.description:
PayoutStep is one asset's payout in a run. Amounts are in base units of 18
 decimals.

amount.description:
What the step pays: the available balance up to the rule's per-run
 ceiling, rounded down to whole units of the destination network. Zero
 when skipped. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.
amount.title: amount

assetId.description:
Asset paid, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
assetId.title: asset_id

available.description: The vault's available balance of the asset when the run started.
available.title: available

chargedNetworkFee.description:
The network fee charged on the withdrawal. On a completed step it was
 taken out of amount, so the destination received amount minus this fee.
 On a failed step whose withdrawal the destination network's bridge
 rejected or failed to execute, it is the fee kept, which is not
 refunded. Unset until the step is final, on a skipped step or one that
 failed before reaching that bridge, and when the fee was not reported;
 never zero for unknown.
chargedNetworkFee.title: charged_network_fee

close.description:
How the step's withdrawal ended once it left the vault, the same close
 as the step's PAYOUT_DEBIT entry in ListVaultLedger: CLOSE_PAID for a
 completed step; for a failed one CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT,
 CLOSE_SENT_TO_RECOVERY, or CLOSE_UNKNOWN when where its funds went is
 not known. Unset (CLOSE_UNSPECIFIED) while the step is not final, and on
 a step that never left the vault, such as a skipped, refused, held or
 released one.
close.title: close

destinationAddress.description: Canonical destination address.
destinationAddress.title: destination_address

minimum.description:
The least amount the rule pays for the asset (the destination's minimum
 in the rule version the run executed). A withdrawal on the network may
 need more, as below_minimum says.
minimum.title: minimum

reason.description:
Machine-readable reason of a skipped or failed step: below_minimum,
 price_unavailable, rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted,
 destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the vault's
 external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; the balance stays
 for a later run), route_suspended (withdrawals to the destination's
 network were suspended; the balance stays for a later run),
 supply_unavailable (the destination route's zToken supply was not known
 or not current; the balance stays for a later run),
 destination_invalid, authority_revoked,
 withdrawal_refused,
 gateway_capacity_insufficient, withdrawal_released (the withdrawal was
 released before it was sent; nothing left the vault) or
 withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying; close says
 where its funds went, see PAYOUT_FAILED); empty otherwise.
reason.title: reason

refundedAmount.description:
The net the destination network's bridge refunded to the vault's own
 smart account, the amount of the step's PAYOUT_REFUND entry; set only
 with CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT, never zero for unknown.
refundedAmount.title: refunded_amount

valueUsd.description:
USD value of the payable amount when the run started, checked against
 Payout.min_usd_value; unset when the rule has no USD minimum or no
 current price valued the asset.
valueUsd.title: value_usd

swap.quickswap.v1.Protection.description:
Protection bounds the worst execution the end user accepts. It is fixed when
 the QuickSwap is created and is enforced on every execution, however long
 after the quote the deposit arrives.

maxSlippageBps.description:
Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's
 min_amount_out and min_rate.
maxSlippageBps.title: max_slippage_bps

minAmountOut.description:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit
 amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the
 quote's min_rate.
min_amount_out must be positive
minAmountOut.title: min_amount_out

swap.quickswap.v1.Protection.title: Protection

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwap.description:
QuickSwap is one broker-owned swap of an external deposit into external
 withdrawals. The end user needs no account.

chargedFees.description:
Service, broker, affiliate and referral fees charged so far, as
 settled: one entry per fee kind, credited account and asset, SERVICE
 first, then BROKER, then AFFILIATE and REFERRAL by account_id, each
 kind and account by asset_id. Grows while the QuickSwap executes or
 pays out a bridge. Each is the rate applied to the actual execution, so
 it can differ from the quote's fee lines. The SERVICE entries are
 Polyester's fee, not an amount credited to the broker: the broker's
 earnings are its BROKER and AFFILIATE entries.
chargedFees.title: charged_fees

deliveredValueUsd.description:
USD value of what the destination is paid (the DESTINATION withdrawal's
 amount: after service, broker and affiliate fees, before its network
 fee), at the destination asset's USD price when that payout was
 requested, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set only once
 that withdrawal is FINALIZED; unset for good when no current price
 valued the payout within minutes of its request or the QuickSwap
 predates USD values; never zero for unknown.
deliveredValueUsd.title: delivered_value_usd

depositInstructions.description:
Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a
 QuickSwap that never got an address (REJECTED, or EXPIRED with
 DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).
depositInstructions.title: deposit_instructions

depositedValueUsd.description:
USD value of the credited deposit taken into execution
 (execution.input_amount), at the source asset's USD price when it was
 taken in, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set once, within
 minutes of that moment, and never repriced. Unset until then, and for
 good when no current price valued it in time or the QuickSwap predates
 USD values; never zero for unknown.
 Setting it increments version.
depositedValueUsd.title: deposited_value_usd

deposits.description:
Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50. A deposit detected earlier
 can appear later and shift the others' index (see Deposit.index).
deposits.title: deposits

depositsTruncated.description:
True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are
 listed.
depositsTruncated.title: deposits_truncated

destinationAddress.description:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and
 memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM
 hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that
 form is the one paid.
destinationAddress.title: destination_address

destinationMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.
destinationMemo.title: destination_memo

execution.description: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.
execution.title: execution

feeScheduleVersion.description:
Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout
 of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, capped by the
 broker's fee ceiling in force at creation if one applies, whatever later
 versions or ceiling changes make.
feeScheduleVersion.title: fee_schedule_version

fees.description:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a
 referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the
 referral's discount and commission.
fees.title: fees

idempotencyKey.description: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.
idempotencyKey.title: idempotency_key

isTerminal.description:
True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values
 added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status
 never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later,
 and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal;
 another deposit reaching the address, before or after it retired, also
 shows as RETURN_ONLY. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through
 withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone
 does not confirm a completed return.
 An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all
 becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user
 reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.
isTerminal.title: is_terminal

quote.description:
Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its
 amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit
 is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the
 actual output and fees.
quote.title: quote

reason.description:
Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without
 destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout
 completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the
 paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is
 REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is
 HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.
reason.title: reason

refundAddress.description: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.
refundAddress.title: refund_address

refundMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.
refundMemo.title: refund_memo

refundZippedAssetId.description:
Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when
 none was supplied.
refundZippedAssetId.title: refund_zipped_asset_id

returnAddress.description: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.
returnAddress.title: return_address

returnMemo.description: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.
returnMemo.title: return_memo

terminalAt.description: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.
terminalAt.title: terminal_at

updatedAt.description: When the QuickSwap last changed.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

version.description:
Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero
 while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT),
 allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT) or
 the QuickSwap is REJECTED; every later change increments it.
version.title: version

withdrawalsTruncated.description: True when more than 50 withdrawals exist; only the first 50 are listed.
withdrawalsTruncated.title: withdrawals_truncated

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapQuote.description:
QuickSwapQuote is the priced view of a QuickSwap's terms. Prices, amounts
 and fees are estimates at quoted_at; only the protection fields are
 guarantees. A QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, which can
 be hours or days after the quote: the deposit must be detected before
 DepositInstructions.funding_expires_at, and its confirmation, credit and
 execution can finish later. Its actual output and fees can therefore
 differ from the quote.

 The end user may deposit any amount from min_deposit_amount to
 max_deposit_amount. min_amount_out applies only to a deposit of exactly
 deposit_amount that fully converts; for any other deposit the guarantee is
 min_rate on the converted part.

 The credit is the deposit less the deposit network fee. Every amount below
 is in token units of its route.

contingentFees.description:
Estimated network fees charged only if funds are not delivered:
 RETURN_NETWORK, then REFUND_NETWORK when the refund route is known. Not
 part of fees or expected_amount_out. A partly traded two-leg QuickSwap can
 be charged both. The fee withheld is the network's fee at payout time.
 Unlike fees, an entry is never omitted: a known fee of zero is listed
 with amount "0".
contingentFees.title: contingent_fees

depositAmount.description:
Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals
 the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.
depositAmount.title: deposit_amount

expectedAmountOut.description:
Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after
 trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An
 estimate, not a guarantee: the delivered amount follows the actual
 deposit, execution and fees, bounded below only by the protection.
expectedAmountOut.title: expected_amount_out

expiresAt.description:
End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after
 quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the
 terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price
 fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies.
 Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

fees.description:
Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's
 service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in
 route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees.
 Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged
 are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these
 amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the service, broker, affiliate
 and referral fees as charged, and Deposit.network_fee and
 Withdrawal.network_fee the network fees.
fees.title: fees

intermediateAssetId.description:
Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for
 example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a
 bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that
 asset. The route is fixed at creation.
intermediateAssetId.title: intermediate_asset_id

maxDepositAmount.description:
Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units,
 compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the
 QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address
 (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book
 bounds.
maxDepositAmount.title: max_deposit_amount

minAmountOut.description:
Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the
 quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully
 converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a
 deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted
 part.
minAmountOut.title: min_amount_out

minDepositAmount.description:
Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the
 deposit before its network fee. Send at least this amount. It is never
 below the source network's minimum deposit
 (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config, for
 DepositInstructions.zipped_asset_id). A smaller deposit is returned to
 return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) only if it reaches the source
 network's minimum deposit; a deposit below that minimum is not detected,
 recorded or returned, and is lost. For a bridge, min_deposit_amount
 often equals the source network's minimum deposit; when they are equal,
 any smaller deposit is lost. It differs from
 ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently
 quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one
 slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum. The deposit
 network fee is charged on the actual deposit and can exceed the quoted
 one: a bridge deposit of at least this amount whose credit after that
 fee is below one base unit of the destination token is also not
 executed (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM, see that reason for how its return
 ends).
minDepositAmount.title: min_deposit_amount

minRate.description:
Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source
 display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits,
 rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the
 way to the destination asset, the destination output before the
 withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to
 destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted
 is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the
 second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to
 return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not
 convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those
 parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the
 output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the
 quote.
minRate.title: min_rate

referral.description:
The referral applied; set only when the request carried a
 referral_code. A QuickSwap's quote keeps the referral fixed at creation:
 later changes to the referral program or partner never change it.
referral.title: referral

Completed QuickSwaps on the route whose deposited or delivered amount

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatsTotals.description:
QuickSwapStatsTotals are the totals of the completed QuickSwaps of a
 period, counted by completion time. Each per-asset list is parallel to a
 list of the response: source_volume and destination_volume to
 GetQuickSwapStatsResponse.zipped_asset_ids, the fee lists to
 GetQuickSwapStatsResponse.fee_asset_ids, with "0" or 0 for an asset with
 nothing in this period.

 USD values are decimal strings of base units of 18 decimals, rounded down,
 and fixed when each amount happened: a deposit when it was taken into
 execution, a delivery when its payout was requested and a fee when it was
 charged. Each is valued once, within minutes, and never repriced, so a
 past period keeps its value. An amount without a USD value is left out of
 the USD sums and counted in unvalued_count or fees_unvalued_count: a
 count equal to the amounts counted means none was valued.

destinationVolume.description:
Exact amounts delivered, per destination asset and network, as decimal
 strings of that asset's base units, after the withdrawal network fee.
destinationVolume.title: destination_volume

destinationVolumeUsd.description: USD value of the delivered amounts that have one.
destinationVolumeUsd.title: destination_volume_usd

fees.description:
Fees charged on those QuickSwaps, per fee asset: the service, broker,
 affiliate and referral fees actually charged, summed over every broker,
 as decimal strings of base units of 18 decimals. Network fees are not
 included.
fees.title: fees

feesUnvaluedCount.description:
Fees of each fee asset without a USD value, left out of
 fees_usd_by_asset and fees_usd.
feesUnvaluedCount.title: fees_unvalued_count

feesUsd.description: USD value of the fees that have one.
feesUsd.title: fees_usd

feesUsdByAsset.description: USD value of each fee asset's fees that have one.
feesUsdByAsset.title: fees_usd_by_asset

sourceVolume.description:
Exact amounts deposited, per source asset and network, as decimal
 strings of that asset's base units (zipped_asset_decimals), before the
 deposit network fee.
sourceVolume.title: source_volume

sourceVolumeUsd.description: USD value of the deposited amounts that have one.
sourceVolumeUsd.title: source_volume_usd

unvaluedCount.description:
Completed QuickSwaps whose deposited or delivered amount has no USD
 value, and so is left out of source_volume_usd or
 destination_volume_usd: not valued by a current price in time, or from
 before USD values existed.
unvaluedCount.title: unvalued_count

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatsTotals.title: QuickSwapStatsTotals

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatsWindow.description:
QuickSwapStatsWindow is a statistics window ending at the end of the
 current bucket, so the latest bucket is still filling. Each has its own
 bucket size.
swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatsWindow.title: QuickSwapStatsWindow

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatus.description:
QuickSwapStatus is the current state of a QuickSwap. While funds progress,
 the status names the earliest gate still outstanding; gates that complete
 concurrently are not reported separately.

 Flow: ALLOCATING → AWAITING_DEPOSIT → (WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY |
 PREPARING_DEPOSIT | CONFIRMING) → CREDITED → EXECUTING (skipped for a
 bridge) → PAYING_OUT | REFUNDING | RETURNING → a terminal status. A
 QuickSwap that cannot be issued a deposit address goes from ALLOCATING
 straight to EXPIRED (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT). A QuickSwap whose source
 wallet failed risk screening is REJECTED from creation and never gets a
 deposit address. A deposit that is dropped
 or replaced on its network before it confirms brings no funds: the
 QuickSwap goes back from PREPARING_DEPOSIT or WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY to
 AWAITING_DEPOSIT, the only status that moves back, and no longer shows
 that deposit. HELD can be
 entered from any non-terminal status and is not terminal; a QuickSwap HELD
 with SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED can end CLOSED. The terminal statuses are
 REJECTED, COMPLETED, REFUNDED, RETURNED, EXPIRED and CLOSED; a terminal status never
 changes, except that EXPIRED becomes HELD when a dropped or replaced
 deposit confirms after all (see EXPIRED). Accept status values added
 later; is_terminal is authoritative.
swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatus.title: QuickSwapStatus

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapSummary.description:
QuickSwapSummary is one QuickSwap in a list: its state and fees. Get it
 with QuickSwapService.GetQuickSwap for its quote, deposit and withdrawals.

chargedFees.description:
Service, broker, affiliate and referral fees charged so far, as
 settled, as on QuickSwap.
chargedFees.title: charged_fees

deliveredValueUsd.description:
USD value of what the destination is paid (the DESTINATION withdrawal's
 amount: after service, broker and affiliate fees, before its network
 fee), at the destination asset's USD price when that payout was
 requested, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set only once
 that withdrawal is FINALIZED; unset for good when no current price
 valued the payout within minutes of its request or the QuickSwap
 predates USD values; never zero for unknown.
 As on QuickSwap.
deliveredValueUsd.title: delivered_value_usd

depositedValueUsd.description:
USD value of the credited deposit taken into execution
 (execution.input_amount), at the source asset's USD price when it was
 taken in, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Set once, within
 minutes of that moment, and never repriced. Unset until then, and for
 good when no current price valued it in time or the QuickSwap predates
 USD values; never zero for unknown.
 As on QuickSwap.
depositedValueUsd.title: deposited_value_usd

fees.description:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation; unset when
 the request set none.
fees.title: fees

idempotencyKey.description: The broker's idempotency key that created it.
idempotencyKey.title: idempotency_key

reason.description: Why the status is notable; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise.
reason.title: reason

updatedAt.description: When the QuickSwap last changed.
updatedAt.title: updated_at

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapSummary.title: QuickSwapSummary

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapTerms.description:
QuickSwapTerms are the economic terms of one QuickSwap. The same terms are
 used to quote and to create, and are echoed unchanged on the QuickSwap.
 Source and destination are either two assets, which are traded, or one asset
 on two networks, a bridge: the deposit is credited and withdrawn to the
 destination network without a trade. Any two zipped_asset_ids from the
 config may be quoted; QuoteQuickSwap is authoritative for whether the route
 is offered.
source and destination must differ

amount.description:
Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source
 route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.
amount must be positive
amount.title: amount

basis.description: Side of the swap that amount denominates.
basis.title: basis

destinationZippedAssetId.description:
Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on
 this network.
destinationZippedAssetId.title: destination_zipped_asset_id

execution.description:
Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only;
 TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.
execution.title: execution

protection.description: Worst execution the end user accepts.
protection.title: protection

sourceZippedAssetId.description:
Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on
 this network.
sourceZippedAssetId.title: source_zipped_asset_id

swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapTerms.title: QuickSwapTerms

swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteBasis.description: QuoteBasis states which side of the swap the request amount denominates.
swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteBasis.title: QuoteBasis

swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteFee.description:
QuoteFee is one fee component of a quote. Trading fees (SERVICE, BROKER,
 AFFILIATE and REFERRAL) are charged when each leg settles, in the asset that leg
 receives: the base asset on a buy, the quote asset on a sell. Each is
 computed on its own from what the leg receives and rounded down when
 charged. A bridge has no settlement; its fees are charged at payout, in
 the destination asset.

 A quoted fee is an estimate, not a fixed amount. What is fixed is the
 rate (bps): each trading fee charged is that rate applied to what the leg
 actually receives once the deposit is credited, which can be hours or days
 after the quote. The quoted amount is not a cap: the fee charged and the
 output follow the actual deposit, execution prices and rounding, so they
 can be higher or lower than quoted.

accountId.description:
AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited
 with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.
accountId.title: account_id

amount.description:
Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a trading fee of the first leg
 of a two-leg route, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision
 (amount.decimals). A REFUND_NETWORK fee, though paid in the intermediate
 asset, is in the refund route's token units and precision (0.72 USDT on
 a 6-decimal route is 720000 with decimals 6). An estimate for
 deposit_amount at the quoted prices, with trading fees rounded up; the
 fee charged can be higher or lower.
amount.title: amount

bps.description:
Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for
 a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the
 leg actually receives.
bps.title: bps

zippedAssetId.description:
Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a
 trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the
 intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).
zippedAssetId.title: zipped_asset_id

swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteFee.title: QuoteFee

swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapRequest.description:
QuoteQuickSwapRequest prices terms, with the broker and affiliate fees,
 without reserving anything.
broker_bps and the affiliates' bps must total at most 300
referral_code cannot be combined with affiliates

affiliates.description:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults.
each affiliate vault may be named once
affiliates.title: affiliates

brokerBps.description:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none,
 at most 300. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300.
brokerBps.title: broker_bps

referralCode.description:
Optional referral partner code, as CreateQuickSwapRequest.referral_code:
 at most 64 bytes.
referralCode.title: referral_code

refundZippedAssetId.description:
Optional refund route, as CreateQuickSwapRequest.refund_zipped_asset_id
 and validated the same way. On a two-leg route it fixes the intermediate
 asset, as create does, and adds REFUND_NETWORK to contingent_fees. It is
 unused on a direct route or a bridge.
refundZippedAssetId.title: refund_zipped_asset_id

sourceWallet.description:
Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, as
 CreateQuickSwapRequest.source_wallet: a valid address on the source
 network, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. When supplied, it is risk screened
 before the quote is returned, and a wallet that fails screening is
 refused with SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED. Source wallets are screened in
 advance on Bitcoin, Solana and most EVM networks. Wallets on other
 networks, including the Bitcoin and Solana test networks, and wallets
 whose screening is unavailable at the time, are quoted without it; their
 deposits are still screened on arrival.
sourceWallet.title: source_wallet

swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapRequest.title: QuoteQuickSwapRequest

quote.description:
Indicative quote, including whether the route needs a refund address.
 Its amounts and fees are estimates. Creating a QuickSwap prices the terms
 again.
quote.title: quote

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralBreakdown.description:
ReferralBreakdown shows how a referred QuickSwap's fee and the partner's
 commission were worked out. Rates are in basis points of what each leg
 receives and are fixed when the QuickSwap is created; a two-leg route
 shows the sum of both legs' rates. For example, on a one-leg route with a
 30 bps fee, a 3 bps discount and a 6 bps commission, the user pays 27 bps
 and the partner earns 6 bps, 20% of the fee before the discount.

baseFeeBps.description:
Fee rate without the referral: the Polyester service fee plus the
 broker fee before the discount.
baseFeeBps.title: base_fee_bps

basis.description: What the commission is a share of: always PRE_DISCOUNT_FEE.
basis.title: basis

chargedFeeBps.description: Fee rate the user pays: base_fee_bps less discount_bps.
chargedFeeBps.title: charged_fee_bps

commissionValue.description:
Value of the commission credited so far in US dollars at the current
 price. Unset when nothing is credited yet or when a credited asset has
 no current price; the amounts are still returned.
commissionValue.title: commission_value

credited.description:
Commission credits, oldest first, at most 100. Their sum per asset is
 ReferredQuickSwap.commission.
credited.title: credited

creditedTruncated.description: True when more than 100 credits exist; only the first 100 are listed.
creditedTruncated.title: credited_truncated

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralBreakdown.title: ReferralBreakdown

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCodeAvailabili.description: ReferralCodeAvailability says whether the caller may take a referral code.
swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCodeAvailabili.title: ReferralCodeAvailability

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommission.description: ReferralCommission is the commission credited to the partner in one asset.

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommission.title: ReferralCommission

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommissionBasi.title: ReferralCommissionBasis

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommissionValu.description:
ReferralCommissionValue is the US dollar value of a QuickSwap's commission

Value of every credited commission at the current price of its asset,
 in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol, rounded down to 6 decimal places. It is
 the value now, not the value when the commission was credited.
usd.title: usd

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommissionValu.title: ReferralCommissionValue

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCredit.description:
ReferralCredit is one commission credit of a QuickSwap: a settled trade
 of one of its legs, or its bridge payout.

accruedAt.description: When the commission was credited, rounded down to the minute.
accruedAt.title: accrued_at

amount.description: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.
amount.title: amount

assetId.description:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
assetId.title: asset_id

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCredit.title: ReferralCredit

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartner.description: ReferralPartner is the caller's referral partner record.

code.description: Current referral code, lower case.
code.title: code

codeChangesRemaining.description:
Code changes left. A partner holds at most 10 codes over its lifetime,
 the one it enrolled with included, because a retired code is never given
 to anyone again; at 0, SetReferralCode refuses a new code with
 REFERRAL_CODE_LIMIT.
codeChangesRemaining.title: code_changes_remaining

earningsSubaccountId.description:
Public sub-account ID of the caller's sub-account credited with the
 commissions. It never changes.
earningsSubaccountId.title: earnings_subaccount_id

linkPath.description:
Path of the share link on Polyester's QuickSwap app: "/r/" followed by
 the code.
linkPath.title: link_path

program.description: Rates the partner earns on; unset while no referral program runs.
program.title: program

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartner.title: ReferralPartner

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartnerStatus.description:
ReferralPartnerStatus is where a referral partner stands. Partners are
 invite-only: Polyester reviews every enrollment.
swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartnerStatus.title: ReferralPartnerStatus

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPricing.description:
ReferralPricing is the referral applied to a QuickSwap, in whole basis
 points of what each leg receives. The end user pays the service fee plus
 base_broker_bps less discount_bps; the broker fee charged is
 base_broker_bps less discount_bps and commission_bps, and the partner is
 credited commission_bps (FeeKind REFERRAL). The service fee is unchanged.
 The rates depend on the route: bridging when nothing is traded,
 stablecoin when every leg trades two stablecoins, normal otherwise.

baseBrokerBps.description: Broker fee without the referral: the request's broker_bps.
baseBrokerBps.title: base_broker_bps

commissionBps.description: Commission credited to the referral partner.
commissionBps.title: commission_bps

discountBps.description: Discount off the end user's fee.
discountBps.title: discount_bps

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPricing.title: ReferralPricing

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralProgram.description:
ReferralProgram is the referral rates of every route category. Polyester
 can change them at any time; a change applies to QuickSwaps created after
 it, and QuickSwaps already created keep their rates.

bridging.description: Moves of one asset between networks.
bridging.title: bridging

normal.description: Swaps between two assets, at least one of them not a stablecoin.
normal.title: normal

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralProgram.title: ReferralProgram

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralRates.description:
ReferralRates are the referral rates of one route category, in whole basis
 points of the swapped amount. Both come out of the broker fee; a referral
 never reduces the Polyester service fee.

discountBps.description: Taken off the referred user's fee.
discountBps.title: discount_bps

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralRates.title: ReferralRates

swap.quickswap.v1.ReferredQuickSwap.description:
ReferredQuickSwap is a QuickSwap the caller referred, as its referral
 partner sees it. It carries no identity of the person who swapped and no
 account, address, memo, transaction hash or flow ID. Amounts are exact;
 every time is rounded down to the minute.

baseFeeBps.description:
Fee rate the user would pay without the referral, in basis points: the
 Polyester service fee plus the broker fee before the discount. Each
 trading leg is charged its rate on what that leg receives, so a two-leg
 route shows the sum of both legs' rates; a bridge has one rate. Fixed
 at creation.
baseFeeBps.title: base_fee_bps

chargedFeeBps.description:
Fee rate the user pays, in basis points: base_fee_bps less the
 referral discount. Fixed at creation.
chargedFeeBps.title: charged_fee_bps

commission.description:
Commission credited so far, one entry per asset in asset_id order. Grows
 while the QuickSwap executes or pays out a bridge; empty until the
 first credit. Each credit is commission_bps applied to what its leg
 actually received, so it can differ from an estimate.
commission.title: commission

commissionBps.description:
Commission rate credited to the partner, in basis points, summed over
 legs as base_fee_bps is. Fixed at creation.
commissionBps.title: commission_bps

createdAt.description: When the QuickSwap was created, rounded down to the minute.
createdAt.title: created_at

destinationAmount.description:
Destination amount delivered, in destination token units; unset until a
 destination payout completes.
destinationAmount.title: destination_amount

destinationZippedAssetId.description:
Destination asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id
 from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
destinationZippedAssetId.title: destination_zipped_asset_id

isTerminal.description: True when status is terminal; a terminal status never changes.
isTerminal.title: is_terminal

quotedDestinationAmount.description:
Destination amount expected at creation, in destination token units; an
 estimate.
quotedDestinationAmount.title: quoted_destination_amount

quotedSourceAmount.description: Source amount quoted at creation, in source token units; an estimate.
quotedSourceAmount.title: quoted_source_amount

sourceAmount.description:
Source amount received, in source token units; unset until a deposit is
 detected.
sourceAmount.title: source_amount

sourceZippedAssetId.description:
Source asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.
sourceZippedAssetId.title: source_zipped_asset_id

status.description:
Current status. Accept status values added later; is_terminal is
 authoritative.
status.title: status

swap.quickswap.v1.TwapExecution.description:
TwapExecution spreads execution evenly over a duration, one slice per
 slot. Slot k starts k slice intervals after execution starts. Each slice
 trades what is left of the credited deposit over the slots left, and is
 protected by the quote's min_rate on what it trades. A slice is sent only
 within its slot: a slot missed is skipped, never sent late. On a two-leg
 route, each slice's second leg converts that slice's intermediate funds
 before the next slice. Intermediate funds below the smallest order the
 second leg's market accepts do not end the TWAP: they are added to the
 next slice's conversion, and what is still unconverted when execution
 ends is refunded to refund_address (INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM). Only the
 second leg's market closing ends a TWAP early. A TWAP needs a larger
 deposit than a market execution, since every slice must be a valid order
 (see QuickSwapQuote.min_deposit_amount). A bridge takes market execution
 only.
slice_interval_ms must not exceed duration_ms

durationMs.description:
Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to
 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when
 the QuickSwap is created.
durationMs.title: duration_ms

sliceIntervalMs.description:
Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to
 duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded
 up.
sliceIntervalMs.title: slice_interval_ms

swap.quickswap.v1.TwapExecution.title: TwapExecution

 It plans exactly as the run does; balances, prices and fees can change

 positive balance, in asset_id order. Empty when the vault has no rule or

computedAt.description: When the balances, prices and fees this preview used were read.
computedAt.title: computed_at

The rule's least USD value of one payout, in base units of 18 decimals;
 unset when the vault has no rule or the rule has no USD minimum.
minUsdValue.title: min_usd_value

nextRunAt.description:
When the next run starts: its UTC slot, or, while a due slot waits to
 start, that slot. For an hourly rule, the next hourly check. Unset when
 the vault has no rule or the rule is paused.
nextRunAt.title: next_run_at

pause.description: Set when the rule paused itself; a rule paused by a member has none.
pause.title: pause

ruleVersion.description: The rule's latest version; zero when the vault has no rule.

UpcomingPayoutAsset is what a vault's next payout run would do with one

assetId.description:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

available.description: The vault's available balance of the asset now.
available.title: available

destinationAddress.description:
Canonical destination address; empty when the rule has no destination

destinationChainId.description:
Destination chain identifier; zero when the rule has no destination for
 the asset.
destinationChainId.title: destination_chain_id

estimatedNetworkFee.description:
The network fee a payout to the destination is expected to be charged,
 from the network's latest sampled fee: an estimate, not the fee charged
 (PayoutStep.charged_network_fee). It is taken out of the payout. Unset
 when the rule has no destination for the asset or the fee is not known
 now.
estimatedNetworkFee.title: estimated_network_fee

estimatedNetworkFeeSampledAt.description: When estimated_network_fee was sampled; unset with it.
estimatedNetworkFeeSampledAt.title: estimated_network_fee_sampled_at

heldBack.description: What would stay in the vault: available minus payable.
heldBack.title: held_back

holdReason.description:
Why held_back stays, or why nothing pays: below_minimum,
 price_unavailable, no_destination (the rule pays no destination for the
 asset), destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the
 vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; see
 payable_from), above_max (the balance above the per-run ceiling stays)
 or dust (less than one whole unit of the destination network stays);
 empty when the whole balance pays.
holdReason.title: hold_reason

minimum.description:
The least one payout of the asset pays: the destination's minimum, or
 the least a withdrawal on its network pays now when that is higher.
 Unset when the rule has no destination for the asset.
minimum.title: minimum

payable.description:
What the run would pay: the available balance up to the rule's per-run
 ceiling, rounded down to whole units of the destination network, or zero
 when it holds.
payable.title: payable

payableFrom.description:
Set only while the destination is cooling down (hold_reason
 destination_cooling_down): when it can be paid, 24 hours after it was
 added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist. Unset with that hold
 reason when the time is not known yet.
payableFrom.title: payable_from

pricedAt.description: When the price behind value_usd was observed; unset with it.
pricedAt.title: priced_at

valueUsd.description:
USD value of what the asset would pay before its minimums, at the
 current price as of priced_at; unset when no current price values it or

Least USD value one payout of the rule pays, in base units of 18

pause.description: Set when the rule paused itself; an Owner or Finance member resumes it.
pause.title: pause

vaultAccountId.description: Public sub-account ID of the vault.
